verdict.rationale: Claude Cowork explicitly supports this story: you describe an outcome, step away, and come back to finished work such as documents, organized files and synthesized research. It handles complex multi-step tasks on your behalf and can run them on a schedule or on demand. Research also works agentically across multiple chained searches. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that background Cowork tasks complete reliably, and documentation of a dedicated review or approval step for the returned output beyond receiving the finished deliverable.
